units: USD absolute; shares absolute; ratios decimal
limitations: Physical/software capex not separately disclosed; aggregate includes intangible assets, no disposal proceeds netted.
Capitalized SBC not separately disclosed; no zero assumption. FCF after SBC expense does not claim to capture unreported capitalized SBC.
D&A less reported depreciation is an approximate residual, not a separately disclosed intangible amortization amount. Annual depreciation rounded to nearest $0.1m. Quarterly depreciation unavailable.
Q4 EPS reconstructed from NI / implied weighted shares; not annual EPS minus YTD EPS.
FY2024 53 weeks; FY2025/26 and both TTMs 52 weeks. No mechanically invented weekly sales normalization.
Use post-split historical comparatives in FY2026 10-K. 2024 original filing has pre-split shares/EPS; do not mix.
17% tax sensitivity is analyst assumption, not management guidance or reported normalized earnings.
